plans.idea: Classic story poster: a big headline block leads at the top, the book cover fills the lower half as a large centred hero, so the canvas reads top-to-bottom with no dead band like the current layout.
Book-cover first: the square book sits full-width in the upper half like a cover reveal, and the headline with its subline anchors the lower half as a solid caption block.
Asymmetric editorial: the book is offset to the upper right, echoing the original's right-side image and circle, and a left-aligned text block sits in the lower part on a shared left edge.
